entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: A legendary minotaur hero of the Dark Age of Terisiare, able to wield magic and fight; his spirit was summoned into a mountainside statue that turned on its summoners.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: A minotaur who summoned Tiyint's spirit into the statue and sacrificed himself to stop it.

entities.name: Pardano
entities.description: Son of Aesor, killed in a cave-in caused by Tiyint's rampage.

entities.name: Living Armor
entities.description: Armor Mytaru donned to drain the statue's life force.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs of northwestern Terisiare who revered Tiyint.

entities.name: Eln Forest elves
entities.description: Elves at war with the minotaurs.

entities.name: Colekgan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where Tiyint's statue was carved.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where the Dark Age took place.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Tiyint lived.

events.summary: Mytaru summons Tiyint's spirit into the statue during the war with the Eln Forest elves.
events.quote: the minotaur Mytaru summoned Tiyint's spirit into the statue, awakening it as a massive stone avatar of war

events.summary: The colossus slaughters elves, then turns on its summoners in a rampage.
events.quote: a command uttered in battlelust suddenly turned the avatar against its summoners

events.summary: Pardano is killed in a cave-in caused by Tiyint's earthquakes.
events.quote: Pardano , son of Aesor , was killed in a cave-in caused by one of these earthquakes.

events.summary: Mytaru sacrifices himself in the Living Armor, ending Tiyint's rampage.
events.quote: Mytaru saw no other way out than to sacrifice himself by donning the Living Armor

relations.note: Summoned Tiyint's spirit into the statue
